BEFORE AN ENGAGEMENT

Clear work.
Clear boundaries.

This page explains the proposed engagement structure. It is not a signed services agreement, a checkout, or a reservation of availability.

Scoping comes first

Work starts only after the parties agree in writing on scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, access, timing, payment, and any relevant confidentiality or ownership terms. A website inquiry does not create an engagement.

Prices and scope

Listed prices are in US dollars. Applicable taxes, final availability, and the exact scope are confirmed in the statement of work.

  • React Delivery Diagnostic ($3,000): one frontend application and one CI pipeline; two stakeholder conversations, findings, a roadmap for the next 90 days, and a live readout. Up to 20 delivery hours over approximately ten business days after agreed access and kickoff. Proposed payment: 50% booking, 50% delivery.
  • Focused Improvement Sprint ($6,000): one agreed workstream, up to 40 delivery hours, typically spread over about four weeks. Proposed payment: 50% booking, 50% at the agreed milestone.
  • Fractional Staff Engineer ($4,500/month): up to 24 hours of agreed support, including meetings, preparation, asynchronous work, and implementation. Proposed payment: monthly in advance. Unlimited support and continuous availability are not included.

Access and changes

Client access and input can affect timing. New work is not silently added to a fixed scope. Material changes require agreement on cost, timing, and acceptance before proceeding.

Confidentiality, intellectual property, and AI

These matters are governed by the signed agreement. The delivery approach is tools approved by the client and access limited to what the engagement requires. Confidential code or data is not entered into AI tools without authorization.

Experience and examples

Founder experience on the site describes Essam Jobory's prior professional work; it is not a claim that those employers were Nabura Labs clients. The sample diagnostic is an original illustration, not a client endorsement or evidence of business results.

No guaranteed outcome

Engineering work involves technical and business dependencies. The website does not guarantee a particular performance gain, revenue increase, delivery date, security certification, or commercial outcome.

Questions

Write to essam@naburalabs.com to discuss fit and scope.
